أهتدي (form VIII)
# أَهْتَدِي (ʔahtadī) /ʔah.ta.diː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِهْتَدَى (ihtadā)
# أَهْتَدِيَ (ʔahtadiya) /ʔah.ta.di.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِهْتَدَى (ihtadā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
